theorem norm_Gr_le_closed (s : ℂ) (δ : ℝ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ : θ < π / 4)
    (hs0 : -1 ≤ s.re) (hs1 : s.re ≤ 1) :
    ‖Gr s δ 0‖ ≤ Real.exp (-(θ * |s.im|)) *
      (Real.exp ((2 * π * |δ| * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 / (2 * Real.cos (2 * θ))) *
        ((1 + (2 * π * |δ| * Real.sin θ / Real.cos (2 * θ)) ^ 2) * √(π / (Real.cos (2 * θ) / 2)) +
          √π / (Real.cos (2 * θ) * √(Real.cos (2 * θ) / 2)))) :=

note: Cor 8.0.2's proof turns (8.3)–(8.4) into (8.50) for |τ| ≥ 20. Erratum: (8.3) is false for small rho when sgn(delta)=sgn(tau): s=1+i, delta=1 gives |F|=0.017470 against 4.16e-8, and s=1+20i, delta=2 (rho=0.507, inside Cor 8.0.2's range) gives 1.29e-28 against 1.18e-40, because the L_3 step applies int_{-oo}^{-ell}e^{-t^2/2}dt<=sqrt(pi/2)e^{-ell^2/2} with ell<0 (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_8_3.py`).
